title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 137
description: Ten questions on Psalms 137: weeping by the rivers of Babylon, the hung-up harps and the vow never to forget Jerusalem.

questions.text: Where did they sit down and weep?
questions.explanation: Psalms 137:1 says, "By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept."

questions.text: On what did they hang up their harps?
questions.explanation: Psalms 137:2 says, "On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps."

questions.text: What did those who tormented them demand?
questions.explanation: Psalms 137:3 says those who tormented them demanded songs of joy: "Sing us one of the songs of Zion!"

questions.text: Where do they ask how they can sing Yahweh's song?
questions.explanation: Psalms 137:4 says, "How can we sing Yahweh's song in a foreign land?"

questions.text: What should happen if the speaker forgets Jerusalem, according to verse 5?
questions.explanation: Psalms 137:5 says, "If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill."

answers.text: His right hand should forget its skill

questions.text: To what should his tongue stick if he doesn't remember Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Psalms 137:6 says, "Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don't remember you."

questions.text: Above what does he want to prefer Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Psalms 137:6 speaks of preferring Jerusalem above his chief joy.

questions.text: Against whom does the psalmist ask Yahweh to remember the day of Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Psalms 137:7 says, "Remember, Yahweh, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem."

questions.text: What did they say in the day of Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Psalms 137:7 says they said, "Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!"

answers.text: "Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!"
"Take all its gold and its silver!"
"Burn its gates and its walls with fire!"

questions.text: How is the daughter of Babylon described in verse 8?
questions.explanation: Psalms 137:8 says, "Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction."
